name: langgraph_imports
description: Imports the START constant and StateGraph class from the langgraph.graph module.

name: typing_extensions_import
description: Imports the TypedDict type from the typing_extensions module for defining structured types.

name: langchain_core_documents_import
description: Imports the Document class from the langchain_core.documents module for handling document objects.

name: langchain_core_output_parsers_import
description: Imports the StrOutputParser class from the langchain_core.output_parsers module for parsing string outputs.

name: State_class
description: Defines a TypedDict named State to structure the data for question, context, and response.

name: State_question_attribute
description: Defines the question attribute of the State class as a string.

name: State_context_attribute
description: Defines the context attribute of the State class as a list of Document objects.

name: State_response_attribute
description: Defines the response attribute of the State class as a string.

name: retrieve_function
description: Defines a function to retrieve documents based on the provided state.

name: retrieve_function_body
description: Calls the qdrant_retriever to invoke document retrieval based on the question in the state.

name: retrieve_return_statement
description: Returns a dictionary containing the retrieved documents as context.

name: generate_function
description: Defines a function to generate a response based on the provided state.

name: generate_chain_setup
description: Sets up a generator chain using the chat prompt, OpenAI chat model, and string output parser.

name: generate_function_body
description: Invokes the generator chain to generate a response based on the question and context in the state.

name: generate_return_statement
description: Returns a dictionary containing the generated response.

name: graph_builder_initialization
description: Initializes a StateGraph object with the State TypedDict to manage the state transitions.

name: graph_builder_add_sequence
description: Adds a sequence of operations (retrieve and generate functions) to the graph builder.

name: graph_builder_add_edge
description: Adds an edge from the START node to the retrieve operation in the state graph.

name: rag_graph_compilation
description: Compiles the state graph into a runnable RAG graph.
